budget_items.what_was_recorded: Sick leave buy-backs from retiring long-term employees exceed the budgeted level, and more significant buy-backs are expected.
budget_items.quote: sick leave buy backs from long term employees who are retiring exceed the budgeted level and the prospect is for other significant sick leave buy-back.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Under the formula the Town is entitled to $293,000 in FY17 Chapter 40S funds but is receiving $116,000; because the funds are not assured, they will be used for non-recurring expenses.
budget_items.quote: by the formula the town is entitled to $293,000, but is receiving $116,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: New growth is arriving slightly above the revised forecast, which was above the original projection, but remains insignificant relative to the total Town budget; an option is to put excess new growth into stabilization.
budget_items.quote: new growth is coming in at a slightly higher rate than the revised forecast, which was higher than the original projection

budget_items.topic: School expenditures share of Town spending
budget_items.what_was_recorded: School Department expenditures net of chapter 70 aid and including encumbrances stayed near 39% of total Town expenditures from FY2011 to FY2015.
budget_items.quote: school department expenditures net of chapter 70 aid and including encumbrances remained nearly constant at around 39% of total town expenditures.

budget_items.topic: Fire truck and police car cost increases
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Fire truck costs are rising 5% per year, above the Town's average revenue increase of about 3.7%, and police car prices rose 10% this year.
budget_items.quote: costs increase for fire trucks increase 5% per year. this exceeds the town's average revenue increases of around 3.7%.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Monty Tech students are building North Cemetery's new tomb for free labor, and the Town will pay only for materials.
budget_items.quote: building-labor is free and the town will only pay for materials.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Sewer Commission is trying to reduce the $2,500 betterment fee on residents of the Pratt Street project and will leave the decision to residents.
budget_items.quote: in order to reduce the $2,500 betterment fee on the residents.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Schools will go from three to two bus runs starting in 2016-17, which may be a cost savings.
budget_items.quote: the schools will go from three to two bus runs. this may be a cost savings.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Bolton joins in FY17 and Berlin in FY18, reducing the assessment by $20,000 per town.
budget_items.quote: bolton joins in fy17 and berlin in fy18, reducing the assessment by $20,000 per town.
